Hello, Dr. Smith. Well, I suppose I came because... well, at church lately, I keep doing these odd things. Well, my mood... I suppose I feel alright. I haven't been terribly sad or anything like that. I don't feel overly excited either, just... normal, really. Just going about my days. Speaking of my days, I usually spend my mornings out on the back porch, watching the birds. I have this lovely little feeder I put out, shaped like a little red barn. Apple, table, penny. Yes, I can say those. Penny... you know, my grandfather used to keep a big glass jug of pennies in the corner of his study.
